Mukhyamantri Example Pension Yojana

Details

Monthly pension for elderly residents. Second sentence.

Benefits

  • ₹1,000 per month

Eligibility

  • Age 60 years or above
  • Resident of the state

How to Apply

  1. Visit the block office
  2. Submit the form

Documents Required

  • Aadhaar card
  • Age proof
